thread:
maria: Deploybot just kicked off a staged rollout for inference-api v3.2.1 -> 5% in eu-west. Change window 23:00-00:30 UTC. pinging @oncall-uk @jordan for stop/go. release notes: https://redwood.local/releases/3.2.1

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary started: service=inference-api version=v3.2.1 region=eu-west target=5%. dashboard: https://dash/rollouts/123. Health checks passing initial smoke. :rocket:
jordan: small p95 drift visible on the dashboard but still inside threshold. what's the formal rollback trigger set for this rollout?
maria: rollback triggers = p95 > 2.5x baseline sustained 5m OR sustained 3%+ 5xx for 5m OR eval regression on smoke promptset. also kvcache miss > 5% for 10m is a soft trigger to pause.
sam: ops note: seeing a brief CPU steal noise on one host in eu-west-2b earlier, nothing escalated yet. will keep an eye. recommend watch for 10m.
oncall-uk: alert just hit at 23:12 — p95 in eu-west spiked to ~320ms (baseline ~120ms). 5xx at 0.6% right now. pasting current snippet.
maria: ```SERVICE: inference-api | TS: 2024-11-23T23:12:14Z | p95=320ms | p99=890ms | 5xx=0.6% | kvcache_miss=4.3% | qps=240```
jordan: kvcache_miss creeping up looks suspicious, could be cache eviction after a restart in that AZ. not yet a hard rollback but worth pausing ramp.
sam: infra checking node events now. if it's a single node OOM or kubelet restart that could explain KV cache warmup behavior.
maria: quick vote: :thumbsup: = hold ramp and pin eu-west, :eyes: = continue. call open for 90s.
jordan: :thumbsup: hold.
oncall-uk: :thumbsup: hold. opening ticket and paging infra.
sam: :thumbsup: hold from ops side too. infra will confirm root cause before we proceed.
maria: got consensus. jordan can you state the exact pin/rollback action?
jordan: recommend pin eu-west to v3.2.0 (previous stable) and stop further percentage increases. keep existing 5% traffic running until infra confirms safe. if 5xx crosses 1% or p95 > 2x baseline for 10m then auto-rollback.
deploy-bot: Action received: pause ramp. holding at 5% in eu-west. To rollback run: `/deploy rollback inference-api v3.2.0 --region eu-west` — no rollback executed yet. Pins: region eu-west -> hold.
maria: I'm going to pin v3.2.1 in ap-south and us-east (no ramp) and explicitly block further EU increases. want to avoid global rollback if it's infra-local.
oncall-uk: infra update: one node had a kubelet OOM and was drained, causing cache cold-starts on its pods. replacing node and warming KV cache should clear p95 within ~15-20m.
sam: ops will stagger replacement to avoid mass drain. once infra confirms steady p95 for 20m we can resume warmup to 20% then 50%.
jordan: agreed. maria, please add the rollback triggers to the rollout notes and flag the change window.
maria: done — rollout notes updated and rollback triggers documented in the rollout page. pinned eu-west back to v3.2.0 for new traffic. deploy-bot just acknowledged pin.
deploy-bot: pin action complete: eu-west pinned to v3.2.0 for new traffic. rollout held at 5% until manual release.
maria: closing this holdcall — state = HELD, follow-up ticket #INF-482. will post a short postmortem and next steps when infra confirms. thanks all :heart:
